name: activity-line
description: One colour-coded row under the prompt and an /activity dashboard: context left before auto-compact, rate limits with reset times, running tools, agents and background shells, todo progress, model and cost.

placement.title: Where the activity line goes
placement.description: below: under the prompt, beneath the hint row. above: in the band above the prompt. pane-only: no line; use /activity.

openPane.title: Open the dashboard at session start
openPane.description: auto: only where there is no line under the prompt (VS Code, mobile). always. never: open it with /activity.
